messages:
Rina P: Hi finance
Quick one from tonight's airport run. Corporate card terminal declined at the drivers mobile POS (soft-decline). Driver accepted cash and gave no itemized receipt, just a handwritten note with amount: €34.20 and license plate. I paid cash and need reimbursement. What do you need?
Expense Bot: Please attach any photo of the handwritten note and a trip detail (ride app screenshot or confirmation). Missing receipts for taxi:
- Manager sign-off required
- Short explanation of why no receipt
Policy: https://redwood.example/policies/expenses (see "missing receipts")
Rina P: Photo attached: https://imgur.com/receipt-taxi. Also attached boarding pass showing arrival time and a photo of the meter. It was a local driver, no official receipt.
Lexi (Finance): Thanks Rina. Steps: 1) Upload photo + boarding pass to Expensify and select "Travel - Taxi"; 2) Get manager sign-off confirming the trip and amount; 3) Finance will accept up to $75 for missing taxi receipt with manager approval per policy. Please add a note: "soft-decline; driver no receipt; paid cash".
Rina P: @Tom (Manager) can you confirm this was work-related and ok to reimburse €34.20?
Tom (Manager): Confirmed  I approve reimbursement of €34.20 for airport pickup.
Marco (Ops): One extra note  if possible next time use the company ride account or our approved airport shuttle vendor to avoid cash. Filing ops follow-up.
Lexi (Finance): Received manager approval. We'll process reimbursement in EUR converted at finance rate on payment date. Please choose "original currency" in the portal and add the handwritten note as an attachment. We'll mark coding TRAVEL-NONRECLAIM (no VAT reclaim for informal driver).
Rina P: Uploaded manager sign-off and selections. Thanks. Also curious: the soft-decline on the corporate card  should we open a dispute? The terminal showed "decline - authorization" but driver took cash.
Lexi (Finance): If it was a terminal error with the merchant, we can open a merchant inquiry. But because you paid cash and there's no electronic authorization, dispute unlikely to recover funds. Finance will flag the charge in the corpcard report for the month. If you prefer, we can initiate a cardholder support ticket to payments ops to check if authorization went through.
Rina P: No need to pursue dispute. Reimbursement is fine. Thanks everyone.
Expense Bot: Expense submitted (ref EXP-2026-01111). Pending AP posting.
